name: xpcog
description: Cross-platform wxWidgets port of the Cog audio player

gui.description: wxWidgets: the application's UI toolkit. A feature rather than a plain dependency so the headless presets, which build no app, do not drag in wx -- and on Linux, GTK -- for a target that links no toolkit at all

vgmstream.description: vgmstream decoder: several hundred video-game streaming formats

mgba.description: mGBA: the Game Boy Advance core behind GSF, one of HighlyComplete's eight

psf-cores.description: Dependencies of the vendored HighlyComplete emulator cores

ffmpeg.description: FFmpeg decoder: AAC, ALAC, WMA, AC3, DTS, TAK, and more (long build)

sid.description: libsidplayfp: the C64 SID core behind the .sid decoder

adplug.description: AdPlug: around forty DOS-era AdLib/OPL2 formats (see ports/adplug)

libvgm.description: libvgm: sound chip emulation behind VGM, S98, DRO and GYM (see ports/libvgm)
